snippet.title: ROCK BAND | Teaser #3
snippet.description:
Rock Band is a chaotic first-person life sim about surviving the neighbourhood, keeping your band alive, and making it to the next concert.

PLAY THE GIG

Concerts are the heart of the game.

Choose what to play, react to the crowd, and try not to fall apart on stage. Good timing builds reputation. Bad timing creates chaos.

SURVIVE THE DAY

Before every show, your band needs to survive the day.

Earn cash, deal with neighbours, find your bandmates, threaten idiots, and take jobs that probably should have been avoided.

Every choice leaves a mark.

A NEIGHBOURHOOD FULL OF BAD IDEAS

Explore a neighbourhood full of strange people, debts, arguments, small jobs, and terrible opportunities.

Some problems can be solved with words.
Some with money.
Some with a guitar case to the face.

BAD DECISIONS WELCOME

Rock Band Simulator is not about becoming the perfect musician.

It’s about broken plans, ugly choices, stupid risks, and those rare moments when everything somehow works.

If that sounds familiar, you are going to feel at home.
